title: 第九章 救下两个女孩，废土女团集结-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一、黑烟

    天刚蒙蒙亮，林霜已然站在厂房屋顶的女儿墙后。

    远方清泉镇的天际线上，一道浓黑烟柱笔直冲天，在灰黄辐射云层笼罩下，像一根僵硬的黑色手指。这绝非寻常篝火炊烟，是轮胎、塑料、建筑木料剧烈燃烧翻涌的毒烟，刺鼻又压抑。

    “苏琳。“她头也不回，声音清冽沉稳，“上来看看。“

    苏琳拄着钢管，一瘸一拐攀上屋顶。左腿经一夜休整，肿胀稍稍消退，骨裂处依旧隐隐作痛。顺着林霜目光望去，脸色骤然一白。

    “那是清泉镇？“

    “地图标注的方位，分毫不差。“林霜递过望远镜，“浓烟从后半夜就升起了。凌晨两点我隐约听到大批引擎轰鸣，现在六点，烟火依旧未歇。“

    苏琳举着望远镜凝望许久，指尖微微发颤，寒意浸透四肢。

    不是风冷，是心底彻骨的凉。

    “镇子还在燃烧。若是普通火情，早该熄灭了。是有人蓄意纵火。“

    “更直白点说，有人攻破了清泉镇，正在焚烧尸体与废墟。“林霜语气平淡，平静得仿佛在陈述天气变化。

    苏琳放下望远镜，转头直视她：“你要过去？“

    “必须去探查。“

    “探查什么？看遍地死尸，还是等着撞上那帮掠夺者？“

    “看有没有漏网的活人。“林霜纵身跃下女儿墙，拍去掌心灰尘，“清泉镇是这片最大的幸存者聚居点，一旦沦陷，幸存者必会四散奔逃，很大一部分会往我们这个方向逃窜。“

    “你打算收留他们？“

    “我要从幸存者口中摸清实情：是谁动的手、兵力多少、如今是否还盘踞在镇上。“她背起***，迈步走向楼梯，“苏琳，你留在据点守家。把一楼厂房大门彻底堵死，除了我，任何人叫门都不许开。“

    “你要一个人去冒险？“

    “两人同行，你的腿只会拖累行进速度。眼下，我们没有第三人可以结伴。“林霜在楼梯口驻足，回头深深看了她一眼，“若天黑前我没回来，你锁死三楼，从地下通道走。别管物资，人活着就行。“

    苏琳张了张嘴，想说不许去，话到嘴边却死死咽了回去。

    废土之上，从来没有任性说“不行“的资格。

    “我等你回来。天黑之前，一定要回来。“

    林霜没有应声，转身走下楼梯，消失在楼道阴影里。

    ## 二、路上

    从废弃工厂到清泉镇，直线距离八公里。

    林霜刻意避开宽敞大路。大道平坦却毫无遮挡，若是攻破清泉镇的势力还在周边游荡，极易正面撞上巡逻队。

    她专走废墟夹缝。塌楼间的碎石道，窄，但比大路隐蔽。走一段，躲一段，四十分钟挪了八公里。

    周遭连片废墟渐渐稀疏，眼前铺开一片荒芜干裂的野地。

    这里曾是战前农田，如今只剩龟裂黄土与几株枯槁死树。地面印着崭新的车轮辙痕，纹路清晰深邃，密密麻麻至少二十道，全部朝着清泉镇方向延伸。

    林霜蹲下身，指尖丈量轮胎宽度与凹陷深度。

    宽胎深纹，重型越野车型，车重不下两吨。二十辆越野车，每辆坐四到五人，少说八十人。加上后勤和押运，总数过百。

    “系统，扫描车辙。“

    “重型越野车，无标识。区域势力中，只有收割者能凑出二十辆战车。“

    又是收割者。

    林霜起身，神色冷沉，脚步再度加快，朝着清泉镇疾驰而去。

    ## 三、清泉镇

    清泉镇的规模，比预想中更大。

    远远望去，整片低层建筑群错落排布，外围环绕着砖石钢板堆砌的围墙，高三米有余。墙面上矗立着几座角钢木板搭建的瞭望塔，如今大多歪斜倾倒，残破不堪。

    围墙南侧裂开一道五米宽的巨大缺口，明显是爆破炸开。缺口边缘砖石呈放射状崩溅，地面残留着黑色爆破灼烧痕迹。林霜蹲下身，拾起一块嵌在泥土里的金属弹片。

    薄铁片，边缘卷曲发烫。土制炸药，硝酸铵配柴油，炸墙够用了。

    她俯身从缺口钻进镇内。

    踏入镇子的一刻，满目皆是人间炼狱。

    楼房外墙布满密密麻麻弹孔，门窗尽数碎裂，家具被拖拽到街道中央焚烧，滚滚黑烟便是由此而起。地面血迹随处可见，有的早已干涸发黑，有的还泛着暗红，是昨夜厮杀留下的痕迹。

    整座镇子，死寂无人。

    没有活人游荡，也没有一具尸体留存。

    “系统，全域百米扫描。“

    “扫描完毕。百米内无任何活体热源。检测大量有机残留：血迹、人体组织、衣物碎片。预估遇难人数不少于五十人。“

    尸体被尽数运走了。要么掩埋、要么投喂变异兽，要么被带去做某种不敢深究的勾当。

    林霜沿着街道往镇中心深入。

    街道两旁多是两三层砖混自建房，还保留着战前烟火痕迹：褪色招牌、碎落玻璃、门口堆积的杂物。一栋四层楼房格外显眼，外墙刷着白漆，大门上方牌匾模糊斑驳，隐约能辨认出“社区中心“四字。

    社区中心的大门歪在一边，铰链炸断了。她侧身进去，一楼大厅桌椅翻倒，墙上宣传板被扯落踩碎。大厅后方搭着一座简易舞台，台上堆满被褥、枕头与破旧衣衫。

    看得出，袭击来临前，大批幸存者曾躲在这里避难。

    如今人去楼空，踪迹全无。

    她拾级走上二楼。二楼皆是办公室与会议室，房门全被暴力撬开，文件散落满地。地板一角，一张泛黄照片映入眼帘。

    照片上二十余人，大多是女性，夹杂几位老人孩童。众人站在社区中心门前，笑容明媚，有人手中还捧着野花编织的花环。

    照片背面，铅笔字褪色模糊：

    **清泉镇妇女互助会，2049年秋。我们还活着。**

    我们活下来了。

    熬过核战浩劫，挺过黑暗年代，在废土艰难扎根活到2049年，却没能熬过2050年这个血色夜晚。

    林霜将照片仔细折好，揣进内兜。

    不是悲悯动容，是把这份仇、这份惨，默默记在心底。

    ## 四、痕迹

    林霜在清泉镇仔细搜寻了整整一小时，走遍街巷角落。

    掠夺者把所有可用物资洗劫一空，留下的尽是破烂杂物、染血废品，毫无价值。

    但她找到了关键痕迹。

    镇子北侧，留有大片临时停车印记：密集车辙、杂乱脚印，还有明显的重物拖行痕迹。拖痕从一栋仓库门口延伸至停车场，最终消失在车轮印记之下。

    她走进那间无窗仓库，铁门虚掩。空气中弥漫着浓烈刺鼻的混杂气味：尿骚、汗臭、血腥，还有深入骨髓的恐惧气息。

    地面遍布小巧光脚印，尺码纤细，全是女子留下的。角落堆积着粪便与呕吐物，散落几件撕碎的衣衫。

    “系统，扫描这个房间。“

    “百平米，密闭，单出口。地面痕迹显示多人长时间滞留。关押人数三十至五十人，滞留时长不少于六小时。“

    林霜蹲下身，手电光束扫过地面，一张皱巴巴带血的纸片映入眼帘。

    是从笔记本撕下的纸页，字迹潦草慌乱：

    **她们被装上车了，往北去了。我们几个逃了出来，躲在镇子东边的林子里。若有人看到纸条，求你来救我们。我们没食没水，撑不了多久。——清泉镇，张小梅。**

    林霜将纸片与照片放在一起收好，转身直奔镇子东侧。

    所谓林子，并非战前密林，而是一片辐射枯死的枯木林。树干灰白光秃，枯枝狰狞伸向天空，占地不大，却足以隐匿藏身。

    “系统，扫描枯木林。“

    “扫描完毕。林地东南角检测到四处女性活体热源，生命体征微弱，伴随严重脱水、失温症状。距离一百五十米。“

    四人幸存。

    林霜脚步一紧，快步冲入枯木林。

    ## 五、林子

    枯木林地面铺满干枯落叶，踩踏间发出沙沙轻响。林霜手持***，箭矢上膛保险关闭，指尖虚搭扳机，随时可击发。

    四处热源藏在一棵倒塌的粗大树干后方，树干直径半米，横卧在地，形成天然掩体。

    渐渐靠近，细微压抑的啜泣声随风传来，断断续续，满是绝望。

    林霜从树干一侧缓缓探头，看清了里面四人。

    四名女子蜷缩在树干与地面的夹角处，裹着破旧衣衫，脸上泪痕混着血污，嘴唇干裂起皮，眼神空洞涣散，是典型的脱水失温状态。

    最外侧短发女子率先察觉来人，瞳孔骤然紧缩，身体本能后缩，右臂却僵在半空不敢发力，只以左手摸索腰间——武器早已被掠夺者搜走，只剩徒劳的防备。

    “别动。“林霜声音低沉平稳，不带敌意，“我不是掠夺者，我叫林霜。我捡到了你留的纸条。“

    女子一怔，沙哑嗓音几不可闻：“纸条……是我塞在门缝的。我叫张小梅。“

    林霜从背包取出水壶，递了过去：“慢一点喝，小口吞咽。“

    张小梅接过水壶，手抖得几乎握不稳。先抿一小口润喉，缓缓咽下，才敢大口补水，随后依次递给身后同伴，默契有序，看得出平日里早已习惯互助求生。
    第(1/3)页

    看得出，袭击来临前，大批幸存者曾躲在这里避难。

    如今人去楼空，踪迹全无。

    她拾级走上二楼。二楼皆是办公室与会议室，房门全被暴力撬开，文件散落满地。地板一角，一张泛黄照片映入眼帘。

    照片上二十余人，大多是女性，夹杂几位老人孩童。众人站在社区中心门前，笑容明媚，有人手中还捧着野花编织的花环。

    照片背面，铅笔字褪色模糊：

    **清泉镇妇女互助会，2049年秋。我们还活着。**

    我们活下来了。

    熬过核战浩劫，挺过黑暗年代，在废土艰难扎根活到2049年，却没能熬过2050年这个血色夜晚。

    林霜将照片仔细折好，揣进内兜。

    不是悲悯动容，是把这份仇、这份惨，默默记在心底。

    ## 四、痕迹

    林霜在清泉镇仔细搜寻了整整一小时，走遍街巷角落。

    掠夺者把所有可用物资洗劫一空，留下的尽是破烂杂物、染血废品，毫无价值。

    但她找到了关键痕迹。

    镇子北侧，留有大片临时停车印记：密集车辙、杂乱脚印，还有明显的重物拖行痕迹。拖痕从一栋仓库门口延伸至停车场，最终消失在车轮印记之下。

    她走进那间无窗仓库，铁门虚掩。空气中弥漫着浓烈刺鼻的混杂气味：尿骚、汗臭、血腥，还有深入骨髓的恐惧气息。

    地面遍布小巧光脚印，尺码纤细，全是女子留下的。角落堆积着粪便与呕吐物，散落几件撕碎的衣衫。

    “系统，扫描这个房间。“

    “百平米，密闭，单出口。地面痕迹显示多人长时间滞留。关押人数三十至五十人，滞留时长不少于六小时。“

    林霜蹲下身，手电光束扫过地面，一张皱巴巴带血的纸片映入眼帘。

    是从笔记本撕下的纸页，字迹潦草慌乱：

    **她们被装上车了，往北去了。我们几个逃了出来，躲在镇子东边的林子里。若有人看到纸条，求你来救我们。我们没食没水，撑不了多久。——清泉镇，张小梅。**

    林霜将纸片与照片放在一起收好，转身直奔镇子东侧。

    所谓林子，并非战前密林，而是一片辐射枯死的枯木林。树干灰白光秃，枯枝狰狞伸向天空，占地不大，却足以隐匿藏身。

    “系统，扫描枯木林。“

    “扫描完毕。林地东南角检测到四处女性活体热源，生命体征微弱，伴随严重脱水、失温症状。距离一百五十米。“

    四人幸存。

    林霜脚步一紧，快步冲入枯木林。

    ## 五、林子

    枯木林地面铺满干枯落叶，踩踏间发出沙沙轻响。林霜手持***，箭矢上膛保险关闭，指尖虚搭扳机，随时可击发。

    四处热源藏在一棵倒塌的粗大树干后方，树干直径半米，横卧在地，形成天然掩体。

    渐渐靠近，细微压抑的啜泣声随风传来，断断续续，满是绝望。

    林霜从树干一侧缓缓探头，看清了里面四人。

    四名女子蜷缩在树干与地面的夹角处，裹着破旧衣衫，脸上泪痕混着血污，嘴唇干裂起皮，眼神空洞涣散，是典型的脱水失温状态。

    最外侧短发女子率先察觉来人，瞳孔骤然紧缩，身体本能后缩，右臂却僵在半空不敢发力，只以左手摸索腰间——武器早已被掠夺者搜走，只剩徒劳的防备。

    “别动。“林霜声音低沉平稳，不带敌意，“我不是掠夺者，我叫林霜。我捡到了你留的纸条。“

    女子一怔，沙哑嗓音几不可闻：“纸条……是我塞在门缝的。我叫张小梅。“

    林霜从背包取出水壶，递了过去：“慢一点喝，小口吞咽。“

    张小梅接过水壶，手抖得几乎握不稳。先抿一小口润喉，缓缓咽下，才敢大口补水，随后依次递给身后同伴，默契有序，看得出平日里早已习惯互助求生。
    第(1/3)页

1. Black smoke

It was just dawn, and Lin Shuang was already standing behind the parapet on the roof of the factory.

On the skyline of Qingquan Town in the distance, a column of thick black smoke soared straight into the sky, like a stiff black finger shrouded in gray-yellow radiation clouds.This is no ordinary campfire smoke. It is the toxic smoke billowing from the violent burning of tires, plastics, and construction wood. It is pungent and depressing.

"Su Lin." She didn't look back, her voice was clear and steady, "Come up and have a look."

Su Lin leaned on the steel pipe and limped up to the roof.After resting overnight in my left leg, the swelling subsided slightly, but there was still a dull pain in the fractured bone.Following Lin Shuang's gaze, his face suddenly turned pale.

"That's Qingquan Town?"

"The directions marked on the map are accurate." Lin Shuang handed over the telescope, "The thick smoke has been rising since the middle of the night. At two o'clock in the morning, I vaguely heard the roar of a large number of engines. Now at six o'clock, the fireworks have still not stopped."

Su Lin held up the telescope and stared for a long time, her fingertips trembling slightly, and the chill soaked into her limbs.

It’s not the wind that’s cold, it’s the chill that’s deep in my heart.

"The town is still burning. If it was an ordinary fire, it would have been extinguished long ago. Someone set the fire deliberately."

"To put it more bluntly, someone has invaded Qingquan Town and is burning corpses and ruins." Lin Shuang's tone was calm, as calm as if he was describing the changes in the weather.

Su Lin put down the telescope and turned to look directly at her: "You want to go there?"

“We must go and investigate.”

"What to explore? To see dead bodies everywhere, or to wait to run into those looters?"

"See if there are any survivors who have slipped through the net." Lin Shuang jumped off the parapet and dusted off the palms of his hands. "Qingquan Town is the largest settlement of survivors in this area. Once it falls, the survivors will definitely flee in all directions, and a large part of them will flee in our direction."

"You plan to take them in?"

"I want to find out the truth from the survivors: who did it, how many troops there are, and whether they are still entrenched in the town." She carried the gun on her back and walked towards the stairs. "Su Lin, you stay at the stronghold and guard the house. Completely block the door of the factory on the first floor. No one is allowed to open the door except me."

"You want to go on an adventure alone?"

"If two people are walking together, your legs will only slow down the progress. Right now, we don't have a third person to accompany us." Lin Shuang stopped at the top of the stairs and looked back at her deeply. "If I don't come back before dark, you lock the third floor and go through the underground passage. Don't worry about the supplies, just stay alive."

Su Lin opened her mouth, wanting to say not to go, but she swallowed the words firmly.

In the wasteland, there is never the right to say "no" willfully.

"I'm waiting for you to come back. You must come back before dark."

Lin Shuang did not respond, turned around and walked down the stairs, disappearing into the shadows of the corridor.

​​ ## 2. On the road

From the abandoned factory to Qingquan Town, the straight-line distance is eight kilometers.

Lin Shuang deliberately avoided the broad roads.The avenue is flat but unobstructed. If the forces that conquered Qingquan Town are still wandering around, it is very easy to bump into the patrol team head-on.

She specializes in walking between ruins.The gravel path between the collapsed buildings is narrow, but more concealed than the main road.Walking part of the way, hiding part of the way, we moved eight kilometers in 40 minutes.

The surrounding ruins gradually became sparse, and a desolate and cracked wilderness spread out in front of them.

This was once farmland before the war, but now only cracked loess and a few dead trees remain.The ground is printed with brand-new wheel ruts, the lines are clear and deep, densely packed with at least twenty tracks, all extending in the direction of Qingquan Town.

Lin Shuang squatted down and measured the tire width and dent depth with her fingertips.

"Wide tires with deep tread, heavy-duty off-road vehicle, weighing no less than two tons.Twenty off-road vehicles, each seating four to five people, at least 80 people.Including logistics and escort, the total number is over one hundred.

"System, scan ruts."

"Heavy off-road vehicles, no markings. Among regional forces, only the Reapers can gather twenty tanks."

It’s the reaper again.

Lin Shuang stood up, with a cold look on his face, and quickened his pace again, galloping towards Qingquan Town.

​ ## 3. Qingquan Town

The scale of Qingquan Town is larger than expected.

Looking from afar, the entire low-rise building complex is scattered and surrounded by a wall made of masonry and steel plates, which is more than three meters high.There are several watchtowers made of angle steel and wooden boards standing on the wall. Most of them are now tilted and dilapidated.

A huge five-meter-wide gap opened on the south side of the wall, apparently caused by a blast.The masonry at the edge of the gap collapsed in a radial pattern, and black blasting burn marks remained on the ground.Lin Shuang knelt down and picked up a piece of metal shrapnel embedded in the soil.

Thin iron sheet with curled and hot edges.Homemade explosives, ammonium nitrate and diesel, are enough to blow up walls.

She leaned over and slipped into the town through the gap.

The moment you step into the town, everything you see is purgatory on earth.

The exterior walls of the building were covered with bullet holes, the doors and windows were all shattered, and the furniture was dragged to the middle of the street and burned. This is where the billowing black smoke started.Bloodstains can be seen everywhere on the ground, some have long dried and turned black, and some are still glowing dark red, which are the traces left by the fighting last night.

The whole town was deserted.

There are no living people wandering around, and not a single corpse remains.

"System, full-area 100-meter scan."

"Scan completed. There is no living heat source within 100 meters. A large number of organic residues were detected: blood stains, human tissue, and clothing fragments. The estimated number of victims is no less than fifty. "

The bodies were all taken away.They were either buried, fed to mutant beasts, or taken to do some kind of deed that they dared not go into.

Lin Shuang walked along the street and went deep into the center of the town.

Both sides of the street are mostly self-built two or three-story brick-concrete houses, which still retain traces of pre-war fireworks: faded signboards, broken glass, and debris piled up at the door.A four-story building is particularly eye-catching. The exterior wall is painted with white paint. The plaque above the door is blurred and mottled, and the four words "Community Center" can be vaguely recognized.

The door to the community center was leaning on one side and its hinges were broken.She entered sideways, and the tables and chairs in the lobby on the first floor overturned, and the promotional boards on the wall were torn off and trampled to pieces.A simple stage was set up at the back of the hall, which was piled with quilts, pillows and shabby clothes.

It can be seen that before the attack, a large number of survivors took refuge here.

Now the building is deserted and there is no trace of it.

She walked up the stairs to the second floor.The second floor was filled with offices and conference rooms. The doors were violently opened and documents were scattered all over the floor.In the corner of the floor, a yellowed photo came into view.

There are more than 20 people in the photo, mostly women, mixed with a few elderly people and children.Everyone stood in front of the community center with bright smiles, and some were holding garlands of wild flowers in their hands.

On the back of the photo, the pencil writing is faded and blurred:

**Qingquan Town Women’s Mutual Aid Association, autumn 2049.We are still alive.**

We survived.

He survived the catastrophe of nuclear war, survived the dark ages, took root in the wasteland and lived until 2049, but he failed to survive the bloody night of 2050.

Lin Shuang folded the photo carefully and put it into her inner pocket.

It’s not that you are moved by compassion, but that you keep this hatred and misery in your heart.

​ ## 4. Traces

Lin Shuang searched carefully for a whole hour in Qingquan Town, walking through all the streets and alleys.

The looters looted all the available supplies, leaving behind only junk, blood-stained junk, and worthless items.

But she found key traces.

On the north side of the town, there are large signs of temporary parking: dense ruts, messy footprints, and obvious signs of heavy objects being dragged.Drag marks stretched from the door of a warehouse to the parking lot, eventually disappearing under the wheel marks.

She walked into the windowless warehouse, the iron door ajar.The air was filled with a strong and pungent mixed smell: urine, sweat, blood, and the smell of fear that penetrated into the bones.

The ground is covered with small bare footprints, slender in size, all left by women.Feces and vomit were piled in the corner, and a few torn clothes were scattered.

“System, scan this room.”

"One hundred square meters, airtight, with a single exit. Traces on the ground show that many people were detained for a long time. The number of people detained was between 30 and 50, and the length of stay was no less than six hours. "

Lin Shuang knelt down, the flashlight beam swept across the ground, and a crumpled and bloody piece of paper came into view.

It is a page torn from a notebook, with scrawled and chaotic writing:

​ **They were loaded into the car and headed north.A few of us escaped and hid in the woods east of the town.If anyone sees the note, please come and save us.We had no food or water, so we couldn't last long.——Qingquan Town, Zhang Xiaomei.**

Lin Shuang put the paper and photos together, turned around and headed straight to the east side of the town.

The so-called forest is not a dense forest before the war, but a forest of dead trees that died due to radiation.The trunk of the tree is gray and white and bare, and the dead branches stretch ferociously toward the sky. It occupies a small area, but it is enough to hide.

"System, scan the dead wood forest."

"Scan completed. Four living female heat sources were detected in the southeast corner of the woodland, with weak vital signs, accompanied by symptoms of severe dehydration and hypothermia. The distance is 150 meters."

Four people survived.

Lin Shuang tightened her steps and rushed into the dead wood forest.

​​ ## 5. Linzi

The floor of the dead wood forest is covered with dry leaves, making a soft rustling sound when stepped on.Lin Shuang held the gun in her hand, the safety on the arrow was turned off, and her fingertips were on the trigger, ready to fire at any time.

The four heat sources are hidden behind a fallen thick tree trunk, half a meter in diameter, lying on the ground, forming a natural shelter.

As he gradually got closer, subtle and suppressed sobs came from the wind, intermittent and full of despair.

Lin Shuang slowly poked his head from the side of the tree trunk and saw clearly the four people inside.

“ Four women were huddled at the angle between the tree trunk and the ground, wrapped in shabby clothes, with tears on their faces mixed with blood, lips that were chapped and peeling, and eyes that were empty and unfocused, a typical state of dehydration and hypothermia.

The short-haired woman on the outermost side was the first to notice the person coming. Her pupils suddenly tightened and her body instinctively shrank back. However, her right arm was frozen in mid-air and she did not dare to use force. She only used her left hand to fumble around her waist - her weapons had already been taken away by the plunderers, leaving only a futile defense.

"Don't move." Lin Shuang's voice was low and steady, without hostility, "I am not a predator, my name is Lin Shuang. I picked up the note you left."

The woman was startled, and her hoarse voice was almost inaudible: "The note... I stuffed it under the door. My name is Zhang Xiaomei."

Lin Shuang took out the water bottle from her backpack and handed it over: "Drink slowly and swallow in small sips."

Zhang Xiaomei took the kettle, her hands shaking so much that she could hardly hold it steady.First, he took a small sip to moisten his throat, swallowed it slowly, and then dared to take a big gulp of water. Then he handed it to his companions behind him in turn, in a tacit and orderly manner. It was obvious that he was already used to helping each other to survive.
